DANIEL.name: Daniel
DANIEL.role: Young sailor, shelters in the basement

steps.title: Feed the boiler
steps.location: Basement engine room, then the lantern room
steps.player_action: Shovel coal into the boiler firebox until the gauge reaches working pressure and the dynamo whines and the beacon flickers. Then climb to the lantern room and inspect the arc lamp to find the burner broken.

steps.title: Let the sailors in
steps.location: Lighthouse window, dock and island gate, then the hall and basement
steps.player_action: Notice the moored rowboat, go to the island gate and open it for the stranded sailors Arthur and Daniel. Daniel goes down to the basement and stays there.

steps.title: Fetch the replacement burner
steps.location: Hall, dock and launch, the Gullwater crossing, and the abandoned outpost
steps.player_action: Talk with Ted and Arthur in the hall, board the launch at the dock, steer the powered engine boat across the Gullwater with Arthur guiding, dock at the abandoned outpost and pick up the replacement burner.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Eclipse, storm season, and the Saltgate howling. Of course they send a new money toff.
lines.subtitle: TED: Eclipse, storm season, and the Saltgate howling. Of course they send a new money toff.
lines.delivery: Gruff, weary, dry. Ends on a cough.
lines.staging: Ted at the lighthouse entrance, wind audible outside.
lines.note: Introduces eclipse, storm season and the Saltgate.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Boiler's cold and the beacon's starving. Down to the engine room. Shovel coal, Isaac.
lines.subtitle: TED: Boiler's cold and the beacon's starving. Down to the engine room. Shovel coal, Isaac.
lines.assist_text: Go to the basement engine room and shovel coal into the boiler firebox until the gauge climbs.
lines.staging: Ted points toward the basement stairs.
lines.note: Creator pick, 2026-10-15. Canon and Review rules applied line by line; the other option in this group was dropped.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: That's the firebox. Feed it coal, mind your sleeves, and don't stand gawping.
lines.subtitle: TED: That's the firebox. Feed it coal, mind your sleeves, and don't stand gawping.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: There she goes. Keep shovelling; the needle won't climb on good intentions.
lines.subtitle: TED: There she goes. Keep shovelling; the needle won't climb on good intentions.
lines.note: Creator pick, 2026-10-15. Canon and Review rules applied line by line; the other option in this group was dropped.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Gauge is waking up. Put your back into it.
lines.subtitle: TED: Gauge is waking up. Put your back into it.
lines.note: Creator pick, 2026-10-15. Canon and Review rules applied line by line; the other option in this group was dropped.

lines.beat: Boiler fed, go to lantern room
lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Hear that dynamo whine? Good. Now up to the lantern room and look over the arc lamp.
lines.subtitle: TED: Hear that dynamo whine? Good. Now up to the lantern room and look over the arc lamp.
lines.delivery: Gruff, a rare note of satisfaction.
lines.assist_text: Climb to the lantern room and inspect the arc lamp.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Arc lamp's in the middle. Open her up and look at the burner.
lines.subtitle: TED: Arc lamp's in the middle. Open her up and look at the burner.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Cracked clean through. The burner's finished. Hrmph. Nothing to mend up here.
lines.subtitle: TED: Cracked clean through. The burner's finished. Hrmph. Nothing to mend up here.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Standing there won't warm the boiler. Think where the heat comes from, Isaac.
lines.subtitle: TED: Standing there won't warm the boiler. Think where the heat comes from, Isaac.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Basement, Isaac. The engine room. Coal's piled by the firebox.
lines.subtitle: TED: Basement, Isaac. The engine room. Coal's piled by the firebox.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Go down to the engine room. Take the shovel. Load coal into the firebox.
lines.subtitle: TED: Go down to the engine room. Take the shovel. Load coal into the firebox.
lines.assist_text: Go to the basement engine room, take the shovel and load coal into the firebox until the gauge climbs.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Rowboat's moored at my dock. Stranded sailors, by the look. Go let them in at the island gate.
lines.subtitle: TED: Rowboat's moored at my dock. Stranded sailors, by the look. Go let them in at the island gate.
lines.assist_text: Go to the island gate by the dock and open it for the stranded sailors.
lines.staging: Ted at the window, wind rattling the glass.
lines.note: Creator pick, 2026-10-15. Canon and Review rules applied line by line; the other option in this group was dropped.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: See them? Soaked and stranded. The gate's down the path from the dock. Go on.
lines.subtitle: TED: See them? Soaked and stranded. The gate's down the path from the dock. Go on.

lines.speaker: ARTHUR
lines.text: Easy now, we mean no harm. Just cold and wet. The gate, please?
lines.subtitle: ARTHUR: Easy now, we mean no harm. Just cold and wet. The gate, please?
lines.note: Creator pick, 2026-10-15. Canon and Review rules applied line by line; the other option in this group was dropped.

lines.speaker: ARTHUR
lines.text: Good hands on that gate. Daniel, move. Quick, now.
lines.subtitle: ARTHUR: Good hands on that gate. Daniel, move. Quick, now.
lines.note: Creator pick, 2026-10-15. Canon and Review rules applied line by line; the other option in this group was dropped.

lines.speaker: ARTHUR
lines.text: Ted, you old rock. Thought you'd be drowned by now.
lines.subtitle: ARTHUR: Ted, you old rock. Thought you'd be drowned by now.
lines.note: Proposal: Ted and Arthur relationship is TBD in lore.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Thought the same of you. Hrmph. Dry yourselves. The boy can warm up downstairs.
lines.subtitle: TED: Thought the same of you. Hrmph. Dry yourselves. The boy can warm up downstairs.
lines.delivery: Gruff, a cough hiding a smile.
lines.note: Proposal pairing with ARTHUR_S2_05. 'The boy' means Daniel.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Down here suits me fine. Did the walls just... never mind. Warm is good.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Down here suits me fine. Did the walls just... never mind. Warm is good.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Arthur says it's just weather. I'm sure Arthur's right. He's usually right. Mostly.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Arthur says it's just weather. I'm sure Arthur's right. He's usually right. Mostly.

lines.staging: Daniel in the basement, close to the wall.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Those sailors won't dry themselves on my dock, Isaac.
lines.subtitle: TED: Those sailors won't dry themselves on my dock, Isaac.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: The gate, Isaac. Down the path from the dock. Someone's shouting out there.
lines.subtitle: TED: The gate, Isaac. Down the path from the dock. Someone's shouting out there.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Walk to the island gate and open it. Let them in.
lines.subtitle: TED: Walk to the island gate and open it. Let them in.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: No burner, no beacon. Outpost, across the Gullwater. Go with Arthur, Isaac.
lines.subtitle: TED: No burner, no beacon. Outpost, across the Gullwater. Go with Arthur, Isaac.

journal.text: Ted says the beacon is starved. Shovel coal into the boiler in the basement engine room until the gauge climbs.
A rowboat is moored at the dock. Open the island gate and let the stranded sailors in.
The burner is cracked. Cross the Gullwater with Arthur, fetch the replacement burner from the outpost, and bring it back.
